'''New Escrow''' was the capital city of the banking [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. It contained the beautiful [[Garden of Butterflies]] and the planet's [[New Escrow's Old Spaceport|oldest spaceport]].
